notes: Pixel quantities (displacement, px/s, flow) are measured directly from the video.
Vehicle boxes and classes come from YOLOX-S (COCO, OpenCV model zoo), gated by motion; motion and trajectories come from Lucas–Kanade.
Pixel values are expressed in source-video pixels.
No calibration was supplied, so no real-world speed is reported. Pixel speed is not convertible to km/h without scene geometry.
